description: This file contains unit test cases for various settings views in a SwiftUI iOS/macOS application. It mocks data and verifies the construction of view bodies for components such as Cron settings, Config, Debug, General, Sessions, Instances, Permissions, About, Voice Wake, and Skills settings.

classes.description: A test suite for verifying the construction of various settings views in the application.
